source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Brownian motion (PDF 4-5).

blocks.text: Brownian motion kisi fluid (maya ya gas) mein mu'allaq chhote zarrat ki be-tarteeb, be-qaida (zig-zag) harkat hai, jo fluid ke molecules ke musalsal takrane se hoti hai. Robert Brown, jo nabatat ke mahir (botanist) the, ne microscope se pollen ke daanon se nikle chhote zarrat ko pani mein idhar udhar harkat karte dekha. Baad mein sabit hua ke yeh molecules ki harkat ka asar hai.

blocks.title: Tareekh aur ta'reef
blocks.text: Kitab saal 1927 likhti hai; Brown ne yeh mushahida 1827 mein kiya. Kitab Brownian motion ko 'gas mein molecules ki be-tarteeb harkat' bhi kehti hai; durust taur par yeh nazar aane wale bare mu'allaq zarrat ki harkat hai, jo gird ke na-nazar aane wale molecules chalate hain.

Molecule har dafa doosre molecule se takra kar apna rasta badalta hai, is liye bar bar takrane wala zarra be-tarteeb, zig-zag rasta chalta hai. Har takkar momentum aur tawanai muntaqil karti hai (Fig 13.1). Brownian motion be-tarteebi (randomness) ke sab se saada models mein se hai. Is ki khaas baatein yeh hain:

items: Chhote, halke zarrat tez harkat karte hain: zarre ko milne wala momentum halke zarre par zyada asar karta hai, is liye us ki raftar zyada hoti hai.
Zarrat ki raftar fluid ki viscosity se ulat talluq rakhti hai: kam viscosity wala fluid tez Brownian motion deta hai.
Viscosity fluid ki andaruni ragar hai, yani bahao ke khilaf us ki mazahmat.
Brownian motion fluid ke zarrat ko musalsal harkat mein rakhti hai.

blocks.alt: Aik cube numa dabba jis mein taqreeban tees chhote gas molecules hain. Har molecule ke saath aik chhota teer us ki velocity dikhata hai, aur teer har taraf be-tarteeb (random) ishara karte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.1: Zarrat be-tarteeb harkat mein hain (kitab ki Figure 13.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Albert Einstein ne 1905 mein maya mein pollen ke zarrat ki harkat ko molecules ke asar se samjhaya. 1908 mein French physicist Jean Perrin ne tajurbe se Einstein ki wazahat ki tasdeeq ki, jis par unhein 1926 ka Physics ka Nobel Prize mila.

blocks.prompt: Chhote zarrat bare zarrat se zyada tez Brownian motion kyun dikhate hain?
blocks.explanation: Chhote zarre ki kamiyat (mass) kam hai, is liye molecules ki takkar ka momentum us ki raftar mein zyada tabdeeli lata hai; neez aik waqt mein kam takkarein hone se us ki aatraf par dhakke kam barabar hote hain.

items: Brownian motion: fluid ke molecules se takrate mu'allaq zarrat ki zig-zag harkat (Brown, 1827).
Halke zarrat aur kam viscosity wale fluid tez harkat dete.
Einstein (1905) ne samjhaya; Perrin (1908) ne tasdeeq ki.
